purpose: Teach: 山上/川本/和泉/玉田/三枝/寺田/岩井/しのぎ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんのお友達の山上おじさんと会われたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father met with his friend Mr. Yamagami.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact. Sharing a small detail from the day as though placing a piece on a table. Even tone, unhurried. The affectionate formality of a mother noticing what her child might have missed.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと川本おじさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I met Dad and Mr. Kawamoto.
lines.style: Clear, factual. Direct eye contact. A small nod of certainty at the end — he's been there, he knows. No embellishment. Simple pride in being included.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「和泉さんは穏やかな方」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father said Mr. Izumi is a calm, gentle person.
lines.style: Thoughtful, slightly distant. Pausing after 「Izumi」 as if considering his father's words. Soft delivery. The tone of someone reflecting on what she's been told rather than merely reporting it.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お父さんがご友人の玉田さんとお茶されてたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and his friend Mr. Tamada were having tea together.
lines.style: Bright, eager. A quick uptick in energy on 「tea」. Forward-leaning slightly — he wants her to know he was paying attention. The enthusiasm of a six-year-old proud of noticing something grown-ups do.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが三枝おじさんとお酒を酌み交わされたわ
lines.en: Sho, your father shared drinks with Mr. Saegusa.
lines.style: Measured, warm. A slight pause before 「shared drinks」 — acknowledging the ritual, the friendship in it. Quiet respect in the delivery. The knowing tone of a wife who understands what these moments mean.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと寺田おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went with Dad to visit Mr. Terada.
lines.style: Pleased, straightforward. Slight lift at the start. Pride in the outing — he was taken, he was included. No flourish, just the quiet satisfaction of a small boy who got to go somewhere with his father.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが岩井おじさんと釣りに行かれるわ
lines.en: Sho, your father will go fishing with Mr. Iwai.
lines.style: Even, gentle. Slight forward motion on 「will go」 — a future event she's telling him about. Warm but composed. The ease of a mother sharing her husband's life with their son.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんが「家計のしのぎ、つまりやりくりが大事」って仰ってたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad said something important — that managing your household budget, taking care of it properly, that's what really matters.
lines.style: Earnest, concentrated. Slower pace on the main thought. He's been thinking about this, holding onto it. Slight breathiness as he finds the words — translating his father's lesson into his own understanding. A child taking something seriously because his father did.
